purpose: Machine-readable registry for /write tag routing and future writable scene objects.
coreRule: No tag, no write. One tag, one destination family. Every writable object must have a tag registry entry before it is connected to /write.

hubbyNote.writeSurface: home powder notebook / 猫窝留言
hubbyNote.notes: This is the default destination when the user says 写猫窝留言 without naming a specific bubble or panel.

useFor: Alex short rotating speech in coffeeCorner
coffeeCorner.notes: Short lines only. This tag belongs to the normal coffeeCorner scene, not lapClose.

windowWeather.writeSurface: home weather window / 窗边叮嘱
useFor: weather note under the home window
windowWeather.notes: Home weather belongs to home. Do not route or name it under coffeeCorner.

lapCloseBubble.writeSurface: lapClose child-scene bubble / 坐腿图气泡
useFor: 隔壁一句：写猫窝所有地方时必须 include this as a target
lapCloseBubble.notes: UI exists and is scene-manifest-owned. Cloud write route may still need a dedicated /write safety test before promotion. Do not reuse [coffeeCorner] for this.

useFor: future short mood note if UI is active
moodNote.notes: Do not use until the current UI has an active moodNote target.

writeAllPlacesPreset.name: allKnownWritablePlaces
writeAllPlacesPreset.description: Use when the user says 写猫窝所有地方 / write all nest places.
writeAllPlacesPreset.rule: If a tag has status active-ui-not-cloud-wired-yet, include it in the generated tagged draft but do not claim /write can publish it until the /write route is safety-tested and promoted.

newWritableObjectChecklist: Add the object to scene manifest / owner registry.
Safety-test /write before promotion if runtime parsing or publishing changes.
antiPatterns: one tag writes to unrelated destinations
adding writable UI without tag registry
promoting /write changes without a write safety test
